Examination Form Filling
Steps For Students
1. Go to Student Login
2. Dashboard > Examination > Exam Form
3. Click on Next, Review all of your Registered Subjects and fees for
that Semester.

4. Click on Submit Form , Read Instructions carefully and submit form.
5. Once Form Submitted then student redirected to fees payment.
Accept Terms & Conditions and click on Pay Button. Do your payment
and wait untill your redirected to next page. I.e View Exam Form.

6. After Successful Payment student can print Exam form & Receipt.

General Instructions:

1.
The detailed schedule about the round execution will be uploaded on the Institute’s website as per
the guidelines and notification of the State CET Cell and all other the competent authorities in due
course of time.
2.
The above schedule is provisional and dates are subject to change as per the guidelines of the competent
authorities.
3.
The updated schedule, if any shall be uploaded on the Institute’s website from time to time.
4.
The candidates must read all the following instructions carefully before applying for this round.
5.
Admission process will be conducted as per rules and regulations published in the information
brochure by State CET Cell for AY 2026 – 27 (for details refer to www.mahacet.org).
6.
ACAP admissions shall be conducted in a transparent manner after the completion of the final CAP
rounds and strictly on the basis of the inter-se merit of eligible candidates.
7.
All candidates shall pay a non-refundable and non-transferable application processing fee of
₹1,000/- online (via QR code) before submitting the ACAP application form.
8.
The candidate should bring the hard copy of transaction details and the application form with all
applicable documents (Incase already admitted candidate bring Previous college Admission
confirmation Letter), at the time of admission process.
9.
All Candidates admitted through ACAP seats shall pay the fees as prescribed by the Fees
Regulating Authority for Unaided Private Professional Educational Institutions for AY 2026-27,
Govt. of Maharashtra, S.P.P.U. and all competent authorities.
10.
Candidates must submit separate online applications for ACAP and Institute Level Quota
admissions.
